content: Rang Hai Rang Hai Mangal Rang hai, Prem Ke Rangon Ka Sangam! 🕉️ Presenting the Song "Mangal Rang (Hindi)" from from "Namit Malhotra’s Ramayana". Namit Malhotra's "Ramayana" Directed by Nitesh Tiwari In Cinemas Worldwide, Diwali 2026. Namit Malhotra’s "Ramayana" Our Truth. Our History. Starring: Ranbir Kapoor as Rama Yash as Ravana Sai Pallavi as Sita Ravie Dubey as Lakshman Sunny Deol as Hanuman Co-Produced by Yash Adapted for Screenplay by Shridhar Raghavan & Nitesh Tiwari Music by Hans Zimmer & A.R. Rahman Lyrics by Kumar Vishwas Audio Credits: Song Composed, Produced and Arranged by A.R. Rahman Vocals - Arijit Singh, Shreya Ghoshal Lyrics - Dr. Kumar Vishwas Music Supervisors - A.R.
